name: Ziro (ZIRO 3D Print Technology Company Limited)
summary: Hong Kong-registered brand with production in Shenzhen, differentiated by an unusually broad range of exotic and novelty aesthetic PLA finishes rather than engineering materials. Ziro also runs its own published OEM/private-label and wholesale programme, so it likely supplies unnamed third-party labels.

product_lines.name: Fluorescent PLA
product_lines.notes: Fluorescent (UV-reactive) pigment, which is not the same as the phosphorescent pigment behind pla-glow.

product_lines.name: Stone PLA
product_lines.notes: Mineral-filler stone-texture PLA; no stone/mineral-filled id in catalog.

product_lines.name: Effect PLA (Diamond, Mystical, Twinkling, Firefly, Chameleon, Iridescent)
product_lines.notes: Glitter/pearlescent/colour-shift pigments on a base PLA.

product_lines.name: Multi-color gradient PLA (Fast Gradient Silk, Gradient Twinkling, Gradient Translucent, Gradient Diamond)
product_lines.notes: Along-strand gradient dyed PLA; Fast Gradient Silk also carries silk luster.

product_lines.name: Fast Gradient Matte PLA / Gradient Matte PLA
product_lines.notes: Matte-additive PLA with an along-strand colour gradient.

product_lines.name: Tri-color / Stripes Matte PLA
product_lines.notes: Multi-filament coextrusion on a matte PLA base; striping is a coex effect, not a dye gradient.

product_lines.name: Tri-color / Stripes Silk PLA
product_lines.notes: Multi-filament coextrusion on a silk PLA base.

product_lines.name: TPU (incl. gradient-color TPU)
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A flexible TPU; gradient SKUs are the same polymer with graded pigment.

additional_notes: Registered at Capital Plaza, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, with factory operations in Shenzhen per its Alibaba company profile; the Shenzhen arm appears as 'Shenzhen Ziro 3d Print Technology Co., Ltd.'. Runs a dedicated OEM section (https://ziro3d.com/pages/oem-section) and a wholesale programme, meaning Ziro may act as an upstream supplier, but no customer brands are named and it does not appear anywhere in the verified-OEM file. PETG and ABS availability could not be confirmed from the pages reviewed. Also sold on Amazon (search 'ZIRO 3D Printer Filament'); no canonical Amazon storefront URL was captured. Build plates not confirmed, so makes_plates is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: Marketing positions Ziro as a 'premium' filament manufacturer while observed pricing matches other Amazon/Newegg budget labels; price_tier follows the pricing evidence, not the marketing copy, and no exact $/kg figure was verified. Two corporate identities (HK holding company and Shenzhen operating arm) appear across sources; the relationship between them is inferred, not documented.
